svg.title: Step 6: what does the policy say?
svg.desc: Deleting is not always right. The policy file decides one of five treatments for each record: delete the whole record (for example a marketing profile), redact names and emails (a support message), anonymize so it can no longer be traced to the person (an analytics row), keep it because the law requires it (a legal hold record), or leave a tombstone with only the stable ID (a closed account). An AI model names the record type only when a file does not say it. The rules are read from the policy file at run time, never hard-coded.
svg.text: Deleting isn’t always right. Some records must be kept, cleaned or anonymized.
